name: Fluidstack

source.quote: In January, Fluidstack raised an $830M Series A at a $7.5B valuation, led by Situational Awareness, with participation from world-leading investors.

description: AI cloud and data center developer building custom GPU campuses for frontier labs, including Anthropic.
explain: Fluidstack was picked by Anthropic to build and run custom data centers in Texas and New York as part of a $50 billion US infrastructure plan, turning a small GPU cloud into a major builder.
